name: Chart
description: Complete quantitative charts with server-rendered SVG, seven geometries, a source table, and a brand-composed pie/donut: the brand decides label placement, leaders, key and ring from documented parts.
whenToUse: Quantitative comparisons, trends, shares and x/y observations. Adopt Chart; the brand's values and its pie/donut COMPOSITION live in chart-composition.tsx (see COMPOSING.md) and the renderer is never edited. Supports bar, stacked-bar, line, pie, donut, scatter and area-scaled bubbles from series.values. Optional centerValue and centerLabel are authored content for a single donut, never an inferred takeaway. Supply locale explicitly when en-US number formatting is inappropriate. All marks and source data render without JavaScript. NOT for decorative statistic bubbles, bespoke illustrations, or interactive dashboards.
